context_requirements: Cells must be proliferating and dependent on CDC25-mediated CDK activation for cell-cycle progression.
Intact p53 pathway for robust CDKN1A/GADD45 induction; p53-mutant lines may show weaker transcriptional response.
Expression of CDC25A/B/C phosphatases as the direct drug targets.
RB-proficient or RB-pathway-responsive cells for clear G1/S and G2/M transcriptional effects.
falsifiers: No decrease in canonical G2/M and proliferation landmark genes (e.g., CCNB1, CDK1, CDC20, AURKA, PLK1) at 6 h or 24 h in any responsive line.
No induction of p53 targets (CDKN1A, GADD45A, SFN) at 6 h or 24 h in TP53-wild-type lines.
Strong and selective upregulation of CDC25A/B/C mRNA at 6 h without downstream cell-cycle gene changes.
A response pattern indistinguishable from generic cytotoxicity with no cell-cycle-specific transcriptional signature.
Clear transcriptional response in all nine lines with equal magnitude, arguing against CDC25-dependence as the mechanism.
